Aditya / Marissa — looping you both in for an approval decision on the non-standard asks from Clairmont (deal RDW-4921). Evelyn routed the request — below are the items and my recommended guardrails. Happy to discuss on short notice.

Summary of external requests: 
1) One-time opt-out after pilot: 30 days notice, one-time termination fee in lieu of remaining committed spend.
2) Downsell protection: after any committed reduction, cap Clairmont's liability at 60% of original committed spend for first 3 months post-downsell (then revert to standard pro-rata).
3) Ramp compression: shorten ramp from 12 months to 9 months.

Karthik's recommended decision (deal desk position):
- Approve in principle with limitations: one-time opt-out allowed for pilots only, charge a termination fee equal to 30% of remaining committed ARR converted to a 90-day equivalent (i.e. not full termination liability). Fee to be paid within 30 days of notice.
- Downsell protection: approve temporary cap but tighten to 60% of committed spend for 2 months (not 3) post-downsell; requires Finance sign-off and a maximum single-use per 24-month period. This prevents repeated carve-outs.
- Ramp: approve 9-month ramp model for this customer provided they sign a milestone schedule (attached spreadsheet) and prepay month 4 if certain usage thresholds are not met.

Conditions for approval:
- Legal must redline SOW v3 with explicit language for the opt-out fee calculation, cap duration, and single-use limitation.
- Finance must provide a waiver document showing impact to revenue recognition.
- This concession is one-off and restricted to Clairmont Health; cannot be referenced as precedent.

Attachments: suggested redline language (I pasted below) and the customer's proposed ramp table are attached.

Karthik pasted suggested contract language: 
"If Customer elects the one-time Pilot Opt-Out within 30 days of the pilot end-date, Customer shall pay a one-time termination fee equal to thirty percent (30%) of the remaining fee for the committed period, calculated on a ninety (90) day equivalence. This fee shall be due within thirty (30) days of notice. The Pilot Opt-Out is available one time only and only in connection with an initial pilot period as defined in Schedule A."

Can you confirm Aditya / Marissa? If yes, Evelyn will relay the approved language to Clairmont and Legal will circulate formal redlines.

Thanks,
Karthik
